items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ll go in and bring the charts and work with Diana Ross to do the charts Billie sang.

ctx.x: They call you Les somebody or something. They made up a name, didn’t they?

What they did was write . . . I have a whole file of letters offering me large sums to give them carte blanche. I said, “No. The only way you can do it is I want the right to approve or disapprove what the character representing me says and does. I don’t mean the dialogue, but the thrust of the dialogue.” “Can’t do that.” They couldn’t make their deal. The other one was, I said, “I’ll go in and bring the charts and work with Diana Ross to do the charts Billie sang. I’ll do it free. I just want . . . in the…
